body:
Ale
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 159
Price 2 sp (gallon), 4 cp (mug); Weight 8 lbs. (gallon), 1 lb. (mug)
Description
Ale is a type of beer brewed from malted barley. It has a sweet, full-bodied, and sometimes fruity taste.
